content.expected_result: Withdrawal edits current state and reason, preserving assertion content and actual Git history.
preconditions: Create a code-scoped deprecation with exact code evidence, then commit its current assertion and active state in a real Git repository.

steps.action: Set the deprecation withdrawn with an authored reason, then inspect current public output and Git history.
steps.expected_result: Current state is withdrawn, its code-scoped assertion and related intent remain present, and committed earlier state is available from Git.

steps.action: Compare assertion content before and after withdrawal and inspect the original Git commit.
steps.expected_result: Assertion content is unchanged; only current withdrawal state/reason changes. The original committed record remains available through Git.

content.title: Withdraw current guidance while preserving its assertion
